disorder-name.detail: Chronic schizophrenia; DSM-IV diagnosis requiring ≥2 psychotic symptoms during a 1-month period; grouped under 'SCZ and SAD-chronic'.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "MRI from individuals with chronic schizophrenia (SCZ; n = 525; age = 37.63 ± 12.06) ... clustered under SCZ and SAD-chronic group ... patients had to meet DSM-IV diagnostic criteria for schizophrenia or schizoaffective disorder"
disorder-name.location: GarciaSanMartin2025.pdf.md: Subjects and Methods / Subjects, paragraph 1

dataset-of-origin.detail: Six datasets: ABCD (n=2), ASRB (n=257), B-SNIP (n=100), UCLA-LA5c (n=48), MCIC (n=104), UKB (n=14). B-SNIP is not in the normalized keyword list; used as-is (Bipolar-Schizophrenia Network on Intermediate Phenotypes, multicenter).

age.detail: Age reported as mean ± SD (min, max) in Supplementary Table 1 for the SCZ chronic group.

sex.detail: Female n=148 reported directly; male n=377 estimated as total (525) minus female (148). Percentages calculated from counts.

disorder-name.supporting_text: "schizoaffective disorder (SAD; n = 62; age = 33.77 ± 10.78), clustered under SCZ and SAD-chronic group"
disorder-name.location: GarciaSanMartin2025.pdf.md: Subjects and Methods / Subjects, paragraph 1

dataset-of-origin.detail: All SAD chronic participants sourced from B-SNIP (Bipolar-Schizophrenia Network on Intermediate Phenotypes). B-SNIP is not in the normalized keyword list; used as-is.

age.detail: Age reported as mean ± SD (min, max) in Supplementary Table 1 for the SAD chronic group.

sex.detail: Female n=37 reported directly; male n=25 estimated as total (62) minus female (37). Percentages calculated from counts.

disorder-name.detail: First episode psychosis; scanned prior to any antipsychotic medication; diagnoses confirmed after 6 months using SCID-I for DSM-IV, including schizophrenia or other psychotic disorder.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "MRI data from individuals who were determined to have experienced a first episode of psychosis (FEP; n = 352; age = 31.43 ± 8.78) ... were obtained from Programa de Atención a las Fases Iniciales de Psicosis (PAFIP)"
disorder-name.location: GarciaSanMartin2025.pdf.md: Subjects and Methods / Subjects, paragraph 2

dataset-of-origin.detail: All FEP participants from PAFIP (Programa de Atención a las Fases Iniciales de Psicosis), a single-site study based at Hospital Universitario Marqués de Valdecilla, Spain. PAFIP is not in the normalized keyword list; used as-is.

age.detail: Age reported as mean ± SD (min, max) in Supplementary Table 1 for the FEP group.

sex.detail: Female n=138 reported directly; male n=214 estimated as total (352) minus female (138). Percentages calculated from counts.

disorder-name.detail: Psychotic experiences (subclinical); three subtypes combined into one PE Minor Category entry: PE-suspected (n=48), PE-definite (n=73), PE-clinical (n=36); total n=157. All sourced from ALSPAC; assessed via PLIKS interview confirmed with SCAN clinical criteria.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "Individuals who were suspected of having had psychotic experiences (PEs; PE-suspected; n = 48; age = 21.55 ± 1.06), or were rated as definitely having PEs (PE-definite; n = 73; age = 21.75 ± 1.59), or have suffered PEs with social decline and/or help-seeking (PE-clinical; n = 36; age = 20.89 ± 0.92) were clustered under the PE subclinical group"
disorder-name.location: GarciaSanMartin2025.pdf.md: Subjects and Methods / Subjects, paragraph 3

dataset-of-origin.detail: All three PE subgroups sourced from ALSPAC (Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children) birth cohort. ALSPAC is not in the normalized keyword list; used as-is.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "All these individuals were sourced from Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children (ALSPAC) birth cohort"
dataset-of-origin.location: GarciaSanMartin2025.pdf.md: Subjects and Methods / Subjects, paragraph 3

age.detail: Three PE subgroups combined: PE-suspected (n=48, mean=21.55, SD=1.06, range=20.78–24.78), PE-definite (n=73, mean=21.75, SD=1.59, range=19.78–24.78), PE-clinical (n=36, mean=20.89, SD=0.92, range=19.78–23.78). Weighted mean = (48×21.55 + 73×21.75 + 36×20.89)/157 = 21.49. Pooled SD = sqrt(((47×1.06²)+(72×1.59²)+(35×0.92²))/154) = 1.31. Min/max are overall range extremes.

sex.detail: Combined across PE subtypes: PE-suspected female=33/48, PE-definite female=42/73, PE-clinical female=28/36. Total female=103, total n=157, male=157-103=54 (estimated). Percentages calculated from counts.

disorder-name.detail: Unaffected first-degree relatives of SCZ (n=96) and SAD (n=64) patients; combined into one SSD entry as the paper groups them as 'SCZ and SAD-relatives'. These individuals are not diagnosed with SSD but are included in the psychosis-related clinical cohort (n=1256) as genetic risk group on the schizophrenia spectrum. No formal psychiatric diagnosis reported.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "MRI data from first-degree relatives of schizophrenia (SCZ-relatives; n = 96; age = 43.75 ± 15.25) and schizoaffective disorder (SAD-relatives; n = 64; age = 40.00 ± 16.20), clustered under SCZ and SAD-relatives group; were obtained from B-SNIP"
disorder-name.location: GarciaSanMartin2025.pdf.md: Subjects and Methods / Subjects, paragraph 4

dataset-of-origin.detail: Both SCZ-relatives and SAD-relatives sourced from B-SNIP (Bipolar-Schizophrenia Network on Intermediate Phenotypes). B-SNIP is not in the normalized keyword list; used as-is.

sex.detail: SCZ-relatives: female=68/96; SAD-relatives: female=43/64. Combined: female=111, total n=160, male=160-111=49 (estimated). Percentages calculated from counts.
